entries.standard: none named on page (unified inch screw clearance drill table)
entries.note: value_mm = inch value x 25.4, rounded to 0.001 mm (my conversion). Cross-checks: TR Fastenings (https://www.trfastenings.com/Knowledge-Base/Engineering-Data/tapping-sizes-and-clearance-holes) lists the same close and free fit drills (#4: 32, 30; #6: 27, 25; #8: 18, 16; #10: 9, 7). The Albany County Fasteners chart (https://www.albanycountyfasteners.com/media/6b/b8/g0/1764944339/clearance-hole-chart.pdf) has the same Close Fit drill, but its Normal Fit is #15 (0.1800) for #8 and #5 (0.2055) for #10, looser than this free fit.
entries.quote: #4 | 32 | 0.116 | 30 | 0.1285 (columns: Size of Screw; Close Fit Drill Size, Decimal Equivalent; Free Fit Drill Size, Decimal Equivalent)
entries.source: Imperial Clearance Hole Sizes | Bolts & Screws | Fractory

value.advice: print critical holes undersized, then drill to size

entries.note: No numeric hole allowance found in a design guide read this session. The page says the amount depends on printer, slicer, hole size and material.
entries.quote: FDM often prints undersized vertical-axis holes. ... The amount of undersize depends on the printer, slicing software, hole size and material. ... If the diameter of the vertical axis hole is critical, the recommendation is to print it undersized and then drill the hole to the correct diameter.
entries.source: How to design parts for FDM 3D printing | Protolabs Network

entries.note: The guide does not state a nozzle size.
entries.quote: Supported Walls Walls that are connected to the surrounding of the part on at least two sides. 1.0[mm] ... Unsupported Walls ... 1.0[mm]
entries.source: Design Guideline FDM (amf.uzh.ch, University of Zurich)
entries.cite: University of Zurich FDM design guideline

entries.note: Absolute floor for a 0.4 mm nozzle: one extrusion width in PrusaSlicer.
entries.quote: The most common size and stock nozzle size on MK3S is 0.4 mm, which in PrusaSlicer has an extrusion width of 0.45 mm. ... Walls thinner than one nozzle perimeter are not printable.
entries.source: Modeling with 3D printing in mind | Prusa Knowledge Base

entries.standard: IEC 61032 test probe B (Figure 2); IEC 60529 IP2X
entries.note: Test equipment maker page, not the standard. Its page lists 'Applied Thrust: 10N ± 0.5N'. IP2X use confirmed on https://moddyren.github.io/IP-Code/IP2X-Access-ProbeB-Jointed-Test-Finger.html: 'This test probe B conforms to the standard requirements of IEC61032 fig.2, IEC60529 IP2X and IEC60065.' (12mm diameter, 80mm finger length).
entries.quote: Knurled Finger Diameter: 12mm ± 0.1mm; Knurled Finger Length: 80mm ± 0.2mm; Standards: IEC 61032 Figure 2; IEC 60529 Figure 1
entries.source: Test Probe B of IEC 61032 - Jointed Test Finger - LISUN

value.at: baseline 40 to 70 in above floor, viewing distance under 72 in

entries.note: 16 mm. Table 703.5.5 rows: 40 to 70 in height: under 72 in viewing 5/8 in; 72 in and more 5/8 in plus 1/8 in per foot beyond 72 in. Over 70 to 120 in: under 180 in viewing 2 in; 180 in and more 2 in plus 1/8 in per foot beyond 180 in. Over 120 in: under 21 ft viewing 3 in; 21 ft and more 3 in plus 1/8 in per foot beyond 21 ft. Height is based on the uppercase I.
entries.quote: Table 703.5.5 Visual Character Height ... 40 inches (1015 mm) to less than or equal to 70 inches (1780 mm) | less than 72 inches (1830 mm) | 5/8 inch (16 mm)
entries.source: U.S. Access Board, ADA Accessibility Standards

entries.quote: Stroke thickness of the uppercase letter "I" shall be 10 percent minimum and 30 percent maximum of the height of the character.
entries.source: U.S. Access Board, ADA Accessibility Standards

entries.note: 16 mm to 51 mm. Exception: 1/2 in (13 mm) minimum where separate raised and visual characters carry the same information.
entries.quote: Character height measured vertically from the baseline of the character shall be 5/8 inch (16 mm) minimum and 2 inches (51 mm) maximum based on the height of the uppercase letter "I".
entries.source: U.S. Access Board, ADA Accessibility Standards

entries.note: 1/32 in = 0.8 mm minimum. The section is 703.2.1 (703.2.2 is Case).
entries.quote: 703.2.1 Depth Raised characters shall be 1/32 inch (0.8 mm) minimum above their background.
entries.source: U.S. Access Board, ADA Accessibility Standards

entries.quote: Stroke thickness of the uppercase letter "I" shall be 15 percent maximum of the height of the character.
entries.source: U.S. Access Board, ADA Accessibility Standards
